results.compositional_note: 2->1: RY(a_g)·RY(a_n) = RY(a_g+a_n); choosing a_g in {pi/4, 3pi/4}, a_n in {0, pi} gives polar angles {pi/4,3pi/4,5pi/4,7pi/4}: the four optimal 2->1 codewords (XZ plane). 3->1: RY(theta_g) with theta_g in {arccos(1/sqrt3), pi-arccos(1/sqrt3)} then RZ(b1)·RZ(b2) = RZ(b1+b2) with b1 in {pi/4, 5pi/4}, b2 in {0, pi/2}: azimuths {pi/4,3pi/4,5pi/4,7pi/4} -> the 8 cube-corner codewords.
